items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Gary Mazzaroppi on bass, myself and Les.

ctx.x: Monday nights are always there at the Iridium in New York City. And we just did King University a couple of weeks ago, that was with Les too. I think we’re supposed to open up some more House of Blues or do Cleveland again. We did, actually we did Cleveland before they even had the rock & roll Hall of Fame built. And that was — Ray Charles was there, the Les Paul Trio. Then we just had the trio. Gary Mazzaroppi on bass, myself and Les. And they didn’t even have the building yet. We did the first where they were…
